name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: Beside Stormwind City's canals, the Flintridge crate yields a clue to Stalvan Mistmantle's past. The torn journal page leads to Marshal Haggard in Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: Unearthing the Past
sections.body: A torn page from Stalvan Mistmantle's journal lies beneath a ceramic vase in a sealed crate. The crate holds musty Flintridge heirlooms, old hunting trophies, and family portraits. Stalvan's own hand offers a glimpse of the reclusive scholar before tragedy struck.

sections.title: A Marshal's Fading Sight
sections.body: Marshal Haggard struggles to read the battered parchment through his failing sight. Its distinctive handwriting stirs his memory of documents and incidents from years past, before darkness took his sight.

faq.q: Where is the sealed crate located?
faq.answer: The sealed crate sits beside the Canals of Stormwind City, directly behind Caretaker Folsom. The Flintridge family's belongings are packed there, and the page found in the crate is taken to Marshal Haggard in southeastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What is inside the sealed crate?
faq.answer: The crate holds dusty heirlooms, a family portrait, old books, hunting trophies, and a ceramic vase. Beneath the vase lies a torn page from Stalvan's journal.

Marshal Haggard is an elderly, retired Stormwind officer who lives alone in southern Elwynn Forest. Though his sight is failing and he is frail, his memories of old records and travelers make him a crucial witness to past events.

faq.q: Why is this journal page important?
faq.answer: The torn page is direct evidence written by Stalvan Mistmantle himself. Its distinctive handwriting and lingering thoughts connect accounts across Duskwood and Elwynn to his personal downfall.

faq.q: What happens when the crate is opened?
aliases: why did a ghost attack me
faq.answer: Disturbing the remnants of Stalvan's past stirs the restless dead. A vengeful Forlorn Spirit manifests and strikes at those trying to unravel the tragedy.

faq.q: Where does the investigation lead next?
faq.answer: After the torn page reaches Marshal Haggard, his memory of the handwriting guides the investigation toward more surviving fragments of Stalvan's history.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator, you uncover how personal horrors in the heart of Elwynn can slip past Stormwind's marshals.
As a human, you see Marshal Haggard as part of Stormwind's aging veteran generation. He carries vital memories of the kingdom before the First and Second Wars tore families apart.
